description: Deals a named layout from the Pipeworx original tarot deck (Rider–Waite–Smith tradition): three_card, situation_obstacle_advice, celtic_cross, horseshoe, yes_no, or a custom set of positions. Each position gets its own card, orientation, and traditional meaning for that orientation. `question` is echoed back verbatim — this tool never interprets it.

positions.description: Required when spread is "custom": the ordered list of position labels (max 20).

question.description: The question this spread is being read for. Echoed back verbatim, never interpreted.

reversals.description: Allow reversed orientation per card (50% chance). Default true.

seed.description: Reproduce a previous spread by passing back the seed it returned. Omit for fresh randomness.

session_id.description: Deal from an open tarot_shuffle session instead of a fresh deal (hosted only; never repeats a card within the session).

name: tarot_spread
title: Tarot Spread
